english.note: Use this for an official notice circulated by a company, school, or organization.
Use 通告 for a written or printed announcement, especially an official notice displayed for people to read.
Use 通告 for an official or public notice issued to inform people rather than sell something.

examples.english: The school issued a bulletin saying classes are suspended tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 學校出咗通告，聽日停課。
examples.jyutping: hok6 haau6 ceot1 zo2 tung1 gou3 ting1 jat6 ting4 fo3

examples.english: A notice has been posted in the lobby saying the power will be cut tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 大堂貼咗張通告，話聽日停電。
examples.jyutping: daai6 tong4 tip3 zo2 zoeng1 tung1 gou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 ting4 din6

examples.english: The management office posted an advertisement saying the water will be shut off tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 管理處貼咗通告，話聽日會停水。
examples.jyutping: gun2 lei5 cyu3 tip3 zo2 tung1 gou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 ting4 seoi2
